opensearch_vector_workflow.overview: This workflow guides you through building vector search and hybrid search on IBM watsonx.data OpenSearch with IBM watsonx.ai embeddings.

actions.action: Obtain OpenSearch cluster host, port, username, and password from IBM Cloud
Verify k-NN plugin is enabled: GET /_cat/plugins?v
Test connectivity with opensearch-py OpenSearch client
Confirm knn_vector field type is available
Create index with knn: true setting
Map vector field as knn_vector with dimension matching embedding model
Select engine: nmslib (default) for most workloads, faiss for billion-scale
Set HNSW parameters: ef_construction=128, m=24 for balanced performance
Map text field as text type for BM25 hybrid search
Download documents from IBM COS using ibm-cos-sdk
Parse and chunk documents (512 tokens, 50 overlap)
Bulk index documents with text and vector fields
Implement k-NN vector search query with knn clause
Implement BM25 keyword search with match query
Combine with bool/should query or hybrid search API
Apply score normalisation (min-max or L2) before combining scores
Tune hybrid_score_weight between 0 and 1 for optimal recall
